ValidationRule.description: When case status is 'Closed: Administratively Resolved (No Outreach)', the Reason_Administratively_Closed must be fill out.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Id ='012d00000021xGK', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed: Administratively Resolved (No Outreach)'), ISBLANK( Reason_Administratively_Closed__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a reason why the case was closed with the status 'Closed: Administratively Resolved (No Outreach)'.
